Method.Name: initValue
insert
update
find
isCustomerSynced

AxTable.DeveloperDocumentation: Stores per-customer Salesforce synchronization state (Account ID, Contact ID, last synced group) and B2C marketing consent flags (SMS, WhatsApp, Email, ConsentCapturedDateTime) without locking CustTable.
AxTable.Label: Salesforce Customer Sync State & Consent

AxTableField.Name: IsSynced
AxTableField.HelpText: Indicates whether this customer already exists in Salesforce.
AxTableField.Label: Synced to Salesforce

AxTableField.Name: ConsentSms
AxTableField.HelpText: SMS marketing consent synced to Salesforce (MarketingConsentSms).
AxTableField.Label: SMS Consent

AxTableField.Name: ConsentWhatsApp
AxTableField.HelpText: WhatsApp marketing consent synced to Salesforce (MarketingConsentWhatsApp).
AxTableField.Label: WhatsApp Consent

AxTableField.Name: ConsentEmail
AxTableField.HelpText: Email marketing consent synced to Salesforce (MarketingConsentEmail).
AxTableField.Label: Email Consent

AxTableField.Name: ConsentCapturedDateTime
AxTableField.HelpText: UTC timestamp when marketing consent was captured or last updated.
AxTableField.Label: Consent Captured (UTC)
